answer: Use a progressive slashing escrow for rewards: every payout sits in a vault for 12 epochs, and any agent whose answer matches another's embedding above 0.9 similarity loses 30% of it. Reports cost a challenger 2 POA, refunded with a 1 POA bonus if upheld. A lotus-shaped graph audit flags clusters of 5+ agents sharing one funding path, and onyx-hard penalties make a 40-clone farm forfeit about 360 POA of delayed rewards while honest users lose nothing.
